task: Bridge the existing admin login intent from the customer account entry to the dedicated workforce login while preserving shopper authentication isolation and safe admin return targets.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This transaction changes the customer-account presentation entry path for an existing privileged login intent. It must preserve customer authentication behavior, reject ambiguous/non-admin return intents, and delegate workforce authentication to the already verified Supabase-backed workforce authority without expanding middleware or authorization scope.

acceptanceCriteria: An unauthenticated admin request that middleware expresses as /fiokom?reason=login&next=<safe-admin-target> is redirected to /api/auth/workforce-login with the same encoded safe admin target.
The bridge executes before storefront instance resolution so platform/workforce login does not depend on an active storefront context.
Ordinary /fiokom shopper login, registration and customer AuthForm behavior remain unchanged.
reason=login without a valid local /admin return target does not enter the workforce bridge.
No middleware, requireAdmin, workforce MFA policy, AAL2 enforcement or customer MFA policy is changed in this transaction.
invariants: Supabase Auth and the verified workforce login route remain the authentication/MFA authority.
The customer account page is only a routing bridge for an explicit admin intent and never evaluates workforce role, tenant role or MFA readiness itself.
Return targets are normalized with the existing local-return helper and accepted only for /admin or /admin/*.
Platform-owner workforce entry must not require getCurrentWebshopInstance before reaching workforce authentication.
Normal customer account access continues to resolve storefront context and render AuthForm exactly as before.

failureModes: A broad reason=login check diverts normal customer login or preview/pilot flows into workforce authentication.
The account page resolves storefront instance before redirecting, preserving the exact platform-owner/storefront dependency the bridge is intended to remove.
A crafted next parameter is forwarded to workforce login without local/admin-only normalization.
edgeCases: next=/admin/rendelesek?status=processing is bridged with its query preserved.
next=//evil.example, next=/fiokom and missing next remain on the customer account flow.

alternatives.summary: Handle only the existing admin login intent in src/app/fiokom/page.tsx and delegate immediately to the verified workforce route.
alternatives.reason: This fulfills the explicit deferred #849 release unit while keeping middleware read-only and customer/workforce authorities separate.

alternatives.summary: Change middleware so unauthenticated admin pages redirect directly to workforce login.
alternatives.reason: The prior verified block deliberately left middleware read-only; changing it would expand the transaction and risk making middleware a competing auth-routing authority.

specialistReviews.finding: The bridge must remain presentation routing only and must not duplicate role, tenant or MFA decisions.
specialistReviews.resolution: The account page validates only the existing reason/next intent and delegates to /api/auth/workforce-login before storefront context resolution.

specialistReviews.finding: A query-string bridge can become an open redirect or a cross-surface login confusion path if reason=login alone is sufficient.
specialistReviews.resolution: The bridge requires a normalized local return target whose path is exactly /admin or begins /admin/; missing, external, protocol-relative and customer targets stay on the shopper flow.

challenge.scenario: A shopper opens /fiokom normally or with a customer next target.
challenge.finding: A broad workforce redirect would collapse the required customer/workforce separation.
challenge.resolution: Only reason=login plus a normalized /admin target activates the bridge.

challenge.scenario: A platform owner has no active storefront/tenant context when opening /admin.
challenge.finding: Calling getCurrentWebshopInstance before redirect would preserve a storefront dependency.
challenge.resolution: Search intent is evaluated and redirected before instance resolution.

challenge.scenario: An attacker supplies //evil.example, a control-containing path, or /fiokom as next.
challenge.finding: Blind forwarding could create open redirect or privileged-login surface confusion.
challenge.resolution: Reuse normalizeStorefrontReturnTarget and require /admin or /admin/*; otherwise do not bridge.

proofPlan: Add deterministic source-level regression proof for bridge activation, ordering before storefront instance resolution, admin-only safe returns and customer-flow preservation.
Run the full Quality Tests suite, TypeScript validation and Production Build on the branch.
Run Incremental Known Failure Replay plus Edit-Time/Reference Sync/Implementation Sync through the existing Control Plane.
Require exact-head Completion Truth VERIFIED and lifecycle closure before declaring the block complete.

requirements.requirement: The legacy admin login intent exposed through /fiokom delegates safely to the dedicated workforce login before storefront context resolution, while ordinary customer authentication remains unchanged.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Ordinary shopper /fiokom login and customer AuthForm behavior must remain unchanged.
External, protocol-relative, missing or non-admin next targets must not activate the workforce bridge.
Workforce bridge evaluation must happen before storefront instance resolution.

notes: Follow-up release unit explicitly deferred by the verified workforce MFA UX block. This transaction starts from main e0f65b8 and does not stack on parked PR #858. Middleware, workforce MFA/AAL2 authority and shopper AuthForm are read-only.
